name: Yamaha CP88/CP73
description: Yamaha CP88/CP73 stage piano: every parameter change table of its V2.00 data list (System, the Live Set Sound with its zones and its Piano, E.Piano and Sub sections), and Pull from the current sound.

sources.title: CP88/CP73 Supplementary Manual V2.00 (H0)
sources.notes: MIDI data format (pages 20, 21) and data tables (pages 22, 23, 24, 25) read by tools/profiles/yamaha/read-yamaha-pdf.mjs from CP88_CP73_supplementary_manual_En_v200_H0.pdf (sha256 64c740da1b332d55a973aa97d00843ab1776d1deb1364af3a65f32898b4c8ded), https://usa.yamaha.com/files/download/other_assets/7/1243337/CP88_CP73_supplementary_manual_En_v200_H0.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/yamaha/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/yamaha/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 1C 08 <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
No identity check: the data list prints the identity reply with the family bytes as `dd dd`, a code for each model (59 06 for the CP73, 5A 06 for the CP88).

Rows the data list prints without an address, taken as the row's before them past its size: BULK CONTROL: Soundmondo Format Version Minor (00 7F 01), BULK CONTROL: Soundmondo Format Version Bugfix (00 7F 02).
Left out, a value over 2 bytes split in a way not read: Live Set Sound Additional: Tempo (46 01 02).

Left out, several settings packed in one byte, a bit each: Zone 1: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 00 0C), Zone 1: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 00 0D), Zone 2: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 01 0C), Zone 2: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 01 0D), Zone 3: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 02 0C), Zone 3: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 02 0D), Zone 4: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 03 0C), Zone 4: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 03 0D).
Pull: Bulk dump request (System); Bulk dump request (Master EQ); Bulk dump request (Contents Unlock); Bulk dump request (Current Sound Buffer). 268 of 268 parameters are read back.

coverage.editBufferDumpRequest: complete: every bulk dump block the data list lists

parameters.description: 4 bytes: 1st bit 3-0: bit 15-12 2nd bit 3-0: bit 11-8 3rd bit 3-0: bit 7-4 4th bit 3-0: bit 3-0. Printed: -102.4 – +102.3 [cent].

parameters.description: Printed: Off, 1 – 118, 119 (Live Set Inc), 120 (Live Set Dec), 121 (Tempo Delay Tap Tempo).
